summary: Mount directories from execution or hybrid nodes into job containers via Paths to expose to isolated jobs using HOST-DIR[:CONTAINER-DIR[:OPTIONS]] with z, O, ro or rw; for rw set the SELinux container_file_t label with semanage and restorecon so the awx user can write.
questions: How do I mount a host directory into an execution environment?
What mount options are supported in Paths to expose to isolated jobs?
SELinux permission denied writing to a mounted directory in a job

answer_card.title: Mount a node directory into job containers
answer_card.answer_md:
Settings > Automation Execution > Job > *Paths to expose to isolated jobs*, format `HOST-DIR[:CONTAINER-DIR[:OPTIONS]]` (options `z`, `O`, `ro`, `rw`):

```
["/var/lib/awx/.ssh:/root/.ssh:O"]
```

For `rw`, label the directory for containers:

```
mkdir /<name> && chmod 777 /<name>
semanage fcontext -a -t container_file_t "/<name>(/.*)?"
restorecon -vvFR /<name>
```
